notes.title: How to play minimal move online co-op on steam
notes.content:
Minimal Move is  playable solo or co-op in local for now, but with Steam's Remote Play, now you can play Minimal Move with your friends on online! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/4be4fc21b5ca3a21e8929ccaf420edd60df3c82b.jpg[/img]

Maybe it's familiar already  if you are using Remote Play on Steam, but for those who is new to  Remote Play, we explain today how to play Minimal Move on Steam with the online co-op mode!

[h2]1 . Log into Steam and launch Minimal Move! [/h2]

You'll see this icon "Remote Play Together" on your screen (bottom right)! 

(You can't click this icon though...)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/7fa1d1627c16482e270b5457b102262c4e7ed68e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/482502acdad0b6aada5a7b79d2b782e22e306247.jpg[/img]

[h2]2. Go to your friends list and invite your friend! [/h2]

Go to your friend list and right-click it on your friend's name. Now  choose "Remote Play Together"!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/7e6ab7b6d97f5c174fbbedc7c8a8df4df7e1a273.jpg[/img]

[h2]3. Your friend will recieve your invitation♡ [/h2]

Say YES! He/she can click "Play the game" (green) button! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/84c1a4edc5810585a7f69712bc2996625ce31c53.jpg[/img]

[h2]4. Go back to Minimal Move! [/h2]

Now you go back to play Minimal Move! You'll see this icon on your screen (bottom right)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/c669cb86c64253ca384ed06632deb727281700a1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/15719cb1133193e7db94c4cd3c51eb337c428eef.jpg[/img]

[h2]5. Enjoy Minimal Move! [/h2]

Choose CO-OP mode on the menu. 

You (person who invite) is going to be a player #1. 

Your friend (person who got invited) is a player #2. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/9ad038b02bd631f88a409abb8c4e15f8ef139119.jpg[/img]

[h2]Have fun!!![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/973d2c629d112dcc962099a88e525bbdfb2c58ba.jpg[/img]

We hope it's easy to understand how to play this game online co-op mode using Remote Play on steam! 


Steam also explain with a video here: https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay


If you have any question regarding to Minimal Move, please feel free to contact us! 


Discord: https://discord.com/invite/G4ajCtD

Twitter: https://twitter.com/MinimalMoveGame

Instagram:  https://www.instagram.com/minimalmovegame/ 

Facebook:  https://www.facebook.com/MinimalMoveGame/

Minimal Move Early Access is now available on Steam!

[h2]Thank you for supporting us![/h2]


日本語でのRemote Playの説明はこちらからどうぞ！：https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay?l=japanese


ぜひお友達とオンラインで遊んでみてください！

＊オンラインコープモードは現在の段階でSteamのみになります。

notes.title: Concept art of Minimal Move!
notes.content:
[b]Minimal Move[/b] is a cooperative puzzle game in [b]3D[/b]! 
But here is our concept art in [b]2D[/b]! 

There will be[b] 7 worlds [/b]for the main story of the game. 

The main characters, [b]Kaiten [/b]and [b]Ido [/b]as the space investigators, land in a wonder cubic world, where they attempt to discover the truth about the planet!  

Each world will have different types of blocks for new ways of playing the puzzle. You can gradually develop your skills step by step.

Today, we introduce you the first three worlds with the 2D art! 
You can already try these 3 worlds on Steam! [b]Try the demo now![/b] 

Which world is your favorite? Please leave your comment below and let us know!

And don't forget to [b]add Minimal Move on your wishlist![/b]

[h1]OASIS WORLD[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/d24ba0315e287cc3228059c366ac63a76e9176ee.png[/img]

This is the very first world when you enter Minimal Move! It’s relatively safe and simple but be careful of cactus. Kaiten and Ido have arrived in this world, now discover how to play with you and your friend! 

[h1]LAVA WORLD[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/89fcff7a37973b19dda98e9ffca40d2daf9aea06.png[/img]

It’s pretty hot here in Lava World! Watch out for your feet because the lava cube can burn you! The guard of this world, Flamin, will try to block your way. 

[h1]LUNAR WORLD [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34598082/d7a1fabb7cb1cd23a02c9ff821f16f5a0338e2a3.png[/img]

The sky gets darker here in Lunar World... The jumper cube can transfer you to another jumper cube. Also, be careful because the robot Beaman is trying to heat up the blocks with his laser beam to catch you!

notes.title: Summer greetings from Tako Studio and new updates!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Happy Summer Greeting from Tako Studio![/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/add4ae2219f3b04da21ec67dc9dffd3ab8f50a94.jpg[/img]

Are you enjoying the good summer breeze? It’s been a while since we wrote you our update. 

After our Kickstarter, we took a good break from the computer for a while and also we prepared for our next move! Now we are fully charged and ready to kick our new start for the rest of 2019! 

And now we have so many exciting news that we want to share with you! Here we go! 


[h1]We are going to Tokyo Game Show![/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/3482f5a09afca533406862f5f0f3aacb69723632.jpg[/img]

We are happy to announce that [b]we have been selected for the Selection Booth of the Indie Game Area at the Tokyo Game Show [/b](TGS)! YES!!! 

This indie booth is free of charge and only selected indie games can be presented there! We are super honored to be one of them and so excited to be able to introduce Minimal Move in TGS! 

TGS is one of the biggest game events in the world! It will be the biggest game event ever for us! We are expected to see many people there! If you are planning to come, please let us know! Please stop by at our stand! We will let you know more information once we got it!

notes.title: 100% reached! Fully funded! Kickstarter completed successfully!
notes.content:
We are literally crying with joy!

We were 100% funded in the last 2 hours!

We finished our kickstarter with 178 backers and €15,110!!!

This is a dream number for us throughout the time of our kickstarter!

It feels incredible to receive such great support and love from everyone! THANK YOU SO MUCH!!!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/f56723aeb2844de5dc180f45e281cdd5c2ddb337.jpg[/img]

We can't describe how thankful we feel.

I know it's not enough to thank you a 100 times, but I want to repeat this word.

Thank you so much for your support.

Thank you for believing in our game, Minimal Move.

Thank you for following our SNS and giving us great feedback and all the little "likes" that encouraged us.

We are excited to be able to finish this game and send it to you!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/320af55b41d55d8cf8b65392c967f8aefed97e7e.jpg[/img]

For our stretch goal, we want to make Minimal Move on Nintendo Switch, and we will surely find a way!

We have also received requests to make this game on Xbox, PlayStation, Mac, Linux, and on the phone too.

We are trying to find a way to do as much as we can!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/b1736ec119865cba075a19d351c1be62bdec14cf.jpg[/img]

Please continue following us on Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook!

Minimal Move will be translated into English, French, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, German, and Russian for now! If you want this game in any other language, please let us know!

We are also keeping a check on our Wishlist on Steam to see which country likes our game the most. This is why we chose these languages first.

Don't forget to add Minimal Move on your Wishlist on Steam and let us know!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/861ff8e1356bb58927578a98806c5940ddcaf9c9.jpg[/img]

Since we did our Kickstarter campaign with just the two of us—Jonathan and I—we worked non-stop for these 2–3 months. Now we are going to rest a bit, and after we are fully charged, we'll kickstart the production of the game!

We will share our process of production with you, so please keep in touch!

Feel free to talk to us anytime! If you have any questions, please let us know!


Thank you so much again and again! 

We want to hug everyone! 

We love you! 

Thank you for making our dream come true!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/ad45beb7aab9ae1233fbe967516d1f370276bb8c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Introducing main character IDO of Minimal Move!
notes.content:
Minimal Move is a cooperative puzzle game in 3D.

The game starts when the two space investigators, Kaiten and Ido landed on a mysterious planet.

[h1]Let us introduce our main character IDO![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/0cf6baa6d03ed23861d364538a2e2d9aa747e526.jpg[/img]

Ido, an intelligent lady!
Her ability is to move blocks to right and left or up and down!
She is very calm and sophisticated independent woman.
She seems cold but actually she has a big heart and always there for friends!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xqC_hpGUtZI&list=PLJjMK00xokRS3wG8rCMUUmwYtmZuzNPws&index=4

The mission is to discover and to reveal the secret of this mysterious planet of Minimal Move.

The good teamwork is a key to success! Good luck!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oln6xI4cQAg&index=2&list=PLJjMK00xokRS3wG8rCMUUmwYtmZuzNPws

Check our more videos on YouTube!

Now we are making in-game animation of IDO!

notes.title: Introducing Lunar World!
notes.content:
[h1]Lunar World... A blue dimly lit world in the moonlight...[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/e2afca6e39de76fbc8c378b103fa428483e824ba.png[/img]

Let's introduce Minimal Move's third world, Lunar world!

It sounds pretty and romantic but it’s getting harder and harder!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/3c7188372fd1c5805eae7c890d8e2fa388d5f606.jpg[/img]

There is a fun cube to play with in this world which is called a Jumper cube!

The jumper cube can transfer Kaiten and Ido to the other jumber cube!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/886ff3ef253d616683fc97c4c5f84277acbdb4a4.jpg[/img]

A new robot in this world, Beaman is heating up blocks by his beam. He will stop you leaving from this world in silence... And yes, the beam can kill KAITEN and IDO... Watch out!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/8a5c6f23f59ad56c5194fe2a60e8eba73573cb6c.jpg[/img]

How to get out from this world!?? More and more challenging!!!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/346c9493b794b7cfd59f63e46f6bf73874b54b4b.jpg[/img]

notes.content:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/0b6b8680cacb13e18da6de82e437344b7b5f141e.png[/img]

Let's introduce Minimal Move's second world, Lava World!

Lava world is much more tricky than Oasis World!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/ee8f9e1b5fd7a0274bce5534f8e6b57a4ed5786f.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/886ff3ef253d616683fc97c4c5f84277acbdb4a4.jpg[/img]

The blocks are dangerous! They can burn them up!

You can move blocks using a Lava block. Watch your steps and use the heat to move blocks!

He is cute, but he can make a block to a lava block so be careful!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/b073b8336201695ff519d948d90e34c4fcb23537.png[/img]

notes.title: Introducing Oasis World!
notes.content:
[h1]Oasis World! What is that?[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/f70f4a3962fc340a2662e6c129045fd2368a6479.png[/img]

Let’s introduce Minimal Move's first world, Oasis World!

This will be the first world that you'll go.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/efb65e7908c5c533639c9c0eabd5dd2f3a43cd9f.jpg[/img]

It’s an introductory world so let’s say it’s pretty much safe.

There are some cactus that block your way.

You'll get used to how to use the controllers, the mechanics of this game, and the most importantly you'll get to know how to think in 3D!

We are so used to see things in 2D on the game, so first you might get confused to think in 3D because the blocks will turn all the way around!



Oasis World is pretty safe but it's a good exercise of your brain!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/45077fa50ea3e5a001687f9c1380f3ccb70543e6.jpg[/img]

In the beginning, you might think it’s difficult, but it’s actually getting simple later!

Next world will be much more dangerous! Be prepared for that!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34598082/2e688459d7d5c1e5141ce1b49b4a6c2df4c03d14.jpg[/img]
